Over 50 million people use Speechify's text-to-speech products to turn whatever they're reading – PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, websites – into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more. Speechify's text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its App of the Day.

Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting – Speechify has no office. These include frontend and backend engineers, AI research scientists, and others from Amazon, Microsoft, and Google, leading PhD programs like Stanford, high growth startups like Stripe, Vercel, Bolt, and many founders of their own companies.

Overview

With the growth of our iOS app, being the #18 productivity app in the App Store category and also our recent recognition as Apple's 2025 Design Award for inclusivity, we find the need for a Senior iOS Engineer to help us support the new user base as well as work on new and exciting projects to push our missing forward.   

This is a key role and ideal for someone who thinks strategically, enjoys fast-paced environments, passionate about making product decisions, and has experience building great user experiences that delight users.

We are a flat organization that allows anyone to become a leader by showing excellent technical skills and delivering results consistently and fast. Work ethic, solid communication skills, and obsession with winning are paramount. 

Our interview process involves several technical interviews and we aim to complete them within 1 week. 

What You'll Do

  • Opportunity to lead key engineering and product decisions
  • Actively shipping production code for the Speechify iOS app
  • Work within a dedicated product team
  • Participate in product discussions to shape the product roadmap
  • Maintain and enhance the existing complex app architecture

An Ideal Candidate Should Have

  • Experience. You've worked on products that scaled to a large user base
  • Track record. You have worked on various products from inception to decent traction. You have been responsible for engineering the product
  • Customer obsession. We expect every team member whose responsibilities directly impact customers to be constantly obsessed about providing the best possible experience
  • Product thinking. You make thoughtful decisions about the evolution of your product and support internal teams and designers into taking the right direction
  • Speed. You work quickly to generate ideas and know how to decide which things can ship now and what things need time
  • Focus. We're a high-growth startup with a busy, remote team. You know how and when to engage or be heads down
  • Technical skills. Swift, SwiftUI

Technical Requirements:

  • Swift Programming Language
  • SwiftUI experience
  • Experience in Multithreading Programming
  • Working with CI/CD infrastructure
  • Experience with Fastlane
  • SOLID principles, the ability to write every single class according to SOLID
  • Experience with Git and understanding of different Git strategies

What We offer:

  • A fast-growing environment where you can help shape the company and product
  • An entrepreneurial crew that supports risk, intuition, and hustle
  • The opportunity to make a big impact in a transformative industry
  • A competitive salary, a collegiate atmosphere, and a commitment to building a great asynchronous culture
  • Work on a product that millions of people use and where daily feedback includes users sharing that they cried when they first found the product because it was so impactful on their lives
  • Support people with learning differences like Dyslexia, ADD, Low Vision, Concussions, Autism, and Second Language Learners, and give reading superpowers to professionals all over the world
  • Work in one of the fastest growing sectors of tech: Intersection of Artificial Intelligence and Audio

Think you're a good fit for this job? 

Tell us more about yourself and why you're interested in the role when you apply.
And don't forget to include links to your portfolio and LinkedIn.

Not looking but know someone who would make a great fit? 

Refer them! 

Speechify is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace.

Speechify does not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other legally protected status.

title: Client Director
description: MISSION Bei STAN sind Client Directors strategische Sparringspartner – keine klassischen Account Manager. Sie führen anspruchsvolle Kundenbeziehungen auf höchstem Niveau, gestalten strategische Diskussionen, erkennen Chancen, bevor sie entstehen, und stellen sicher, dass jede Zusammenarbeit die Qualität, den Anspruch und die Denkweise widerspiegelt, für die STAN steht. Sie übernehmen die ganzheitliche Verantwortung für den Erfolg ihrer Kunden und tragen gleichzeitig aktiv zu Strategie, Wachstum und exzellenter kreativer Arbeit bei. DEINE AUFGABEN Client Leadership & Strategische Partnerschaft Werde vertrauensvoller Sparringspartner für unsere Kunden und baue Beziehungen auf, die weit über einzelne Projekte hinausgehen. Übernimm die vollständige Verantwortung für den Erfolg, die Entwicklung und das Wachstum deines Kundenportfolios und stelle sicher, dass kein Detail verloren geht und jede Zusammenarbeit außergewöhnlichen Mehrwert schafft. Erkenne Kundenbedürfnisse, geschäftliche Herausforderungen und neue Chancen, bevor sie von deinen Kunden selbst identifiziert werden. Berate CEOs, Gründer:innen, CMOs und weitere Führungskräfte souverän zu Themen wie Unternehmensstrategie, Markenentwicklung, kultureller Relevanz, Innovation, Partnerschaften und Wachstum. Führe strategische Gespräche, moderiere Workshops und begleite komplexe Stakeholder-Prozesse mit Klarheit, Souveränität und Überzeugungskraft. Strategische Beratung Entwickle strategische Narrative, Positionierungen, kulturelle Plattformen und Wachstumsstrategien mit nachhaltiger Wirkung. Übersetze komplexe unternehmerische Herausforderungen in klare strategische Empfehlungen und umsetzbare Lösungen. Erarbeite Strategien, schärfe Botschaften, optimiere Präsentationen und hinterfrage Denkansätze, um jede Arbeit auf das nächste Niveau zu heben. Arbeite eng mit den STAN Foundern sowie den Teams aus New Business, Strategy, Creative, Production, Social und AI zusammen, um strategisches Denken in außergewöhnliche Umsetzung zu übersetzen. Verbinde Ideen, Branchen und Chancen auf unerwartete Weise und schaffe dadurch strategische Wettbewerbsvorteile für unsere Kunden. Kundenerfolg & Qualität Übernimm die Gesamtverantwortung für die Kundenbeziehung – von der strategischen Ausrichtung bis zur finalen Umsetzung. Fungiere als Qualitätsinstanz für sämtliche Kundenprojekte und stelle sicher, dass jede Arbeit den kreativen Ansprüchen von STAN entspricht. Hinterfrage Ideen kontinuierlich, schärfe Ergebnisse und hebe gemeinsam mit den Teams das strategische und kreative Niveau. Sorge dafür, dass Projekte mit höchster Qualität, Konsistenz und Liebe zum Detail umgesetzt werden. Wachstum & Geschäftsentwicklung Erkenne Potenziale, bestehende Kundenbeziehungen durch neue Projekte, strategische Partnerschaften und langfristige Retainer auszubauen. Entwickle Angebote, Leistungsumfänge und strategische Empfehlungen, die sowohl für unsere Kunden als auch für STAN nachhaltigen Mehrwert schaffen. Baue vertrauensvolle Beziehungen auf, aus denen langfristige Partnerschaften, Folgeprojekte und Weiterempfehlungen entstehen. Beziehungsentwicklung Entwickle langfristige Partnerschaften, die auf Vertrauen, Glaubwürdigkeit und exzellentem Service basieren. Erkenne Potenziale, bestehende Kundenbeziehungen weiterzuentwickeln und nachhaltige Kooperationen aufzubauen. Werde durch proaktives Denken, Verlässlichkeit und strategische Führung zu einem geschätzten Teil der Teams unserer Kunden. Repräsentiere STAN souverän in Kundenterminen, Workshops, internationalen Präsentationen und Branchenevents. Leadership Führe interdisziplinäre Teams mit Empathie, Klarheit und hohen Qualitätsansprüchen. Inspiriere und fördere Kolleg:innen und schaffe ein Umfeld, in dem außergewöhnliche Arbeit entstehen kann. Übernimm Verantwortung statt lediglich zu koordinieren – indem du mit gutem Beispiel vorangehst und selbst aktiv zu strategischen und kreativen Ergebnissen beiträgst. DEIN PROFIL Strategische Führungspersönlichkeit Mindestens 6-8 Jahre Berufserfahrung in einer führenden Kreativagentur, Markenberatung oder Strategieberatung. Umfangreiche Erfahrung in der Führung internationaler Kunden sowie komplexer Stakeholder-Strukturen. Fundiertes Verständnis von Unternehmensstrategie, Markenentwicklung, Cultural Strategy, Innovation, Experience Design und integrierter Kommunikation. Nachweisbare Erfahrung darin, strategische Empfehlungen zu entwickeln und überzeugend vor Führungskräften und Entscheidungsträgern zu präsentieren. Hands-on-Berater:in Du koordinierst nicht nur Spezialisten, sondern arbeitest selbst aktiv an den Inhalten mit. Du entwickelst Strategien, optimierst Präsentationen, moderierst Workshops, schärfst Botschaften und hinterfragst Denkansätze. Du verbindest strategische Exzellenz mit unternehmerischem Verständnis und einer außergewöhnlich hohen Umsetzungsqualität. Du erkennst Chancen frühzeitig, löst Probleme proaktiv und bringst Projekte mit Eigeninitiative voran. Beziehungsmanager:in Du baust Vertrauen auf, bevor es um Geschäft geht. Du entwickelst langfristige Partnerschaften, anstatt Projekte lediglich zu verwalten. Du verstehst es, Kunden zu inspirieren, herauszufordern und zu überzeugen, ohne tragfähige Beziehungen zu gefährden. Du überzeugst durch Souveränität, Präsenz und ein sicheres Urteilsvermögen auf Executive-Ebene. Unternehmerisches Denken Du erkennst Potenziale, Kundenbeziehungen durch strategisches Denken und vertrauensvolle Partnerschaften nachhaltig weiterzuentwickeln. Du fühlst dich sicher im Umgang mit Angeboten, Leistungsumfängen und langfristigen Zusammenarbeitsmodellen. Du verstehst, wie exzellente Kundenführung nachhaltiges Unternehmenswachstum ermöglicht. Qualitätsanspruch Du verfügst über ein außergewöhnliches Gespür für Qualität und höchste Ansprüche an jedes Detail. Du hebst die Qualität jeder Arbeit und inspirierst dein Umfeld dazu, denselben Anspruch zu verfolgen. Dir sind kreative Exzellenz und messbarer geschäftlicher Erfolg gleichermaßen wichtig. Persönliche Eigenschaften Neugierig, unternehmerisch denkend und von Natur aus proaktiv. Ruhig und souverän – auch in dynamischen oder unklaren Situationen. Begeistert für Kultur, Kreativität, KI, Innovation und die Zukunft von Marken und Unternehmen. Hervorragende Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (nahezu muttersprachliches Niveau) sind Voraussetzung. Weitere Sprachkenntnisse wie Deutsch, Französisch oder Arabisch sind von Vorteil. Erfahrung oder Interesse im Bereich Women's Health ist von Vorteil. Verfügbarkeit Wohnsitz in den USA, idealerweise in New York oder Los Angeles. Die Zusammenarbeit startet zunächst auf Freelance-Basis mit der Perspektive, diese langfristig in eine Festanstellung zu überführen. Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Admin Services - Senior Country Commercial Manager - UK
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3><strong>A</strong><strong>BOUT TIDE</strong></h3> <p>At Tide, we help SMEs save time and money in the running of their businesses by not only offering business accounts and related banking services, but also a comprehensive set of highly usable and connected administrative solutions, from invoicing to accounting.</p> <p>Tide is transforming the small business banking market and now supports over 2 million members globally across the UK, India, Germany and France.</p> <p>Using advanced technology, all solutions are designed with SMEs in mind. With quick onboarding, low fees and innovative features, we thrive on making data driven decisions to serve our mission: to help SMEs save time and money so they can get back to doing what they love.</p> <p><strong>Tide facts:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Tide is available for UK, Indian, German and French SMEs</li> <li>Over 2 million members: 900,000 UK and 1,100,000 in India and growing rapidly</li> <li>Over $300 million raised in funding</li> <li>Over 2,800 Tideans globally</li> <li>Recognised with Great Place to Work certification three years in a row, and among India’s Top 50 Best Workplaces in Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance in 2026</li> <li>We have offices in Central London, with a member support and technology centre in Sofia, Bulgaria, technology centres in Serbia, Romania, Lithuania and Hyderabad and offices in Gurugram, New Delhi, Berlin, Paris and Luxembourg</li> </ul></div><h2>About the team&nbsp;</h2> <p>The Admin Services commercial team are responsible for driving adoption and usage of essential products for Small Business Owners.&nbsp; This includes Tide’s range of accounting packages, as well as invoicing, expense management, payroll and Company Formations / Company Secretariat services.&nbsp; Most of these are sold on a subscription basis, providing consistent value to members and a consistent revenue stream to Tide. &nbsp; The team works closely with Product, Finance, Business Insights, CRM and Operations teams to translate member and commercial insights into appealing product enhancements, effective positioning, and strategies that enhance engagement and retention.&nbsp;</p> <h2>About the role<strong>&nbsp;</strong></h2> <p>We’re looking for an exceptional Senior Country Commercial Manager to drive revenue growth from our Invoicing and Expense Management products, as well as leading on our Accountant GTM. You will sit at the heart of Tide’s commercial function, and be responsible for collaborating with cross-functional teams to understand product performance, uncover opportunities, and work across multiple areas to deliver.&nbsp; This will require a relentless focus on the numbers and our members, product prioritisation, and detailed planning to ensure revenue targets are hit and customer lifetime value is always increasing.<br><br>In this role, you will be responsible for the strategy and implementation of core activities to drive activation and usage of Invoicing and Expense Management as well as unlocking growth out of Accountants. This includes close partnership with marketing teams to ensure seamless delivery of ‘always on’ campaign activity.&nbsp; This role will also own the strategy and launch approach for new product launches, ensuring that all channels and member touch points are considered.&nbsp; This includes end-to-end journeys and transaction channels.&nbsp; You’ll need to partner effectively with multiple stakeholders to make this happen – excellent organisation and communication skills essential.</p> <p><strong>Some of the things you’ll be doing:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Revenue Ownership &amp; Forecasting</strong>: Partner closely with Finance and key stakeholders to set, track, and refine financial projections for Invoicing, Expense Management and Accountants, ensuring revenue accountability and proactive identification of risks and opportunities.</li> <li><strong>Analytics-Driven Insight: </strong>with the support of the BI team you will analyse member behaviour, segment audiences, and measure subscription cohort&nbsp; performance. You will then translate this data into clear recommendations that shape product prioritisation, pricing, positioning and communications.</li> <li><strong>Product Development: </strong>Leveraging the commercial and analytics insights, you will partner with the Product teams to address areas of opportunity.&nbsp; This will include shaping product positioning, product led growth, aligning on roadmaps and supporting&nbsp; successful product launches with tailored GTM strategies.</li> <li><strong>Launch Strategy</strong>: &nbsp; You’ll support new feature launches across channels, partnering with excellent sales, and operations teams to deliver best-in-class experiments.&nbsp; You’ll facilitate brainstorm sessions / workshops to surface creative ideas and implementation plans.</li> <li><strong>Stakeholder Management:&nbsp; </strong>As you’ll be working in a highly collaborative way, it will be key to communicate regularly with a wide range of stakeholders.&nbsp; This will include Tide’s Senior Leadership Team as well as the C-Suite.</li> <li><strong>Commercial &amp; Competitor Intelligence:</strong> Lead ongoing commercial research and competitive analysis to monitor trends, and benchmark to translate it into actionable strategies that strengthen and differentiate Tide’s positioning and value proposition.</li> <li><strong>Member Obsession:</strong> You will be or become an expert in the core motivations of our members in order to focus on bringing their voice to commercial and product design discussions.</li> </ul> <h2>What we are looking for&nbsp;</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Strong commercial acumen</strong>:&nbsp; Proven experience in driving commercial impact, partnering with finance to understand performance and identify opportunities to improve.&nbsp; Able to set and track clear KPIs across all initiatives to meet revenue goals.</li> <li><strong>5+ years’ experience leading ‘always on’ activity to drive commercial performance.&nbsp; </strong>&nbsp;This will ideally be with specific experience in Accounting, Invoicing or Expense Management products, ideally in a fintech environment – key is demonstrated ability to plan and deliver consistent activity that drives commercial impact.</li> <li><strong>Strong analytical mindset</strong>: Able to review and interpret data to develop hypotheses and assumptions, turning insights into clear, actionable plans.</li> <li><strong>Proven GTM track record</strong> – delivering holistic, high impact omni-channel campaigns&nbsp; (across sales, CRM, in-app contact points)</li> <li><strong>Exceptional project management skills</strong>, able to juggle multiple launches and tactical tests in a fast-moving environment.</li> <li><strong>Creative collaborator: </strong>Builds relationships across teams, crafts compelling messaging and navigates ambiguity with confidence.</li> <li><strong>Self-starter attitude</strong>: Works backwards from targets, removes blockers proactively and adapts when priorities shift.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h2>What you’ll get in return</h2> <ul> <li>Competitive salary&nbsp;</li> <li>Vitality Health Insurance, with a proactive focus on mental and physical wellbeing</li> <li>Hundreds of perks and discounts through Vitality Health Insurance (fitness watches, Waitrose cashback, gym membership etc.)</li> <li>24/7 Employee Assistance Programme</li> <li>25 days holiday with the ability to buy extra days</li> <li>Professional L&amp;D budget per year</li> <li>Referral bonus when you bring your friends to join Tide&nbsp;</li> <li>Access to ‘salary sacrifice’ benefits such as Cycle to Work scheme and pension contribution</li> <li>Spacious brand new office in Liverpool street with an all-day snacks bar</li> <li>Enhanced family-friendly leave</li> <li>24 hours paid volunteering time off per year</li> <li>Flexible work from home or at the office arrangements</li> <li>Monthly team socials (we’ve had themed bingo, online cocktail making sessions, wellbeing challenges and themed virtual pub quizzes)</li> <li>Sabbatical leave&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>TIDE IS A PLACE FOR EVERYONE</h3> <p>At Tide, we believe that we can only succeed if we let our differences enrich our culture. Our Tideans come from a variety of backgrounds and experience levels. We consider everyone irrespective of their ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, veteran, neurodiversity or differently-abled status. We celebrate diversity in our workforce as a cornerstone of our success. Our commitment to a broad spectrum of ideas and backgrounds is what enables us to build products that resonate with our members’ diverse needs and lives.&nbsp;</p> <p>We are One Team and foster a transparent and inclusive environment, where everyone’s voice is heard.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><em>At Tide, we thrive on diversity, embracing various backgrounds and experiences. We welcome all individuals regardless of ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, or disability. Our inclusive culture is key to our success, helping us build products that meet our members' diverse needs. We are One Team, committed to transparency and ensuring everyone’s voice is heard.</em></p> <div class="p-rich_text_section">&nbsp;</div> <div class="p-rich_text_section"><strong>Disclaimer</strong></div> <div class="p-rich_text_section">&nbsp;</div> <div class="p-rich_text_section"><em>It has come to our attention that individuals or agencies are falsely claiming to represent Tide and are reaching out to candidates regarding job opportunities. title: Senior Sales Development Representative
description: About Achievers Achievers offers more than just a thank you program. Our employee recognition and rewards software inspires employees to recognize everyone, every day, everywhere. With 4.3 million global users, we empower employees across 190 countries. Visit us at achievers.com to learn more and check out our platform in action. Join our team of A-players who bring passion to our purpose and believe that meaningful change creates extraordinary outcomes — together, we’ll inspire recognition everywhere and achieve results that matter.  Our commitment to you: At Achievers, we hire you for you because we value the unique perspective and individuality that each person brings to our team. We are committed to creating an inclusive, diverse, and equitable workplace where you belong, and your contributions are celebrated. Together, we achieve more by combining our unique strengths, fostering collaboration, and inspiring each other to reach new heights.  The opportunity: As a Senior Sales Development Representative (Sr. SDR), you will play a critical role in driving pipeline generation and revenue growth across the EMEA region. Building upon core sales development expertise, you will own strategic prospecting initiatives, develop targeted account penetration strategies, and partner closely with Account Executives, Marketing, and Revenue Operations to create qualified opportunities within enterprise and mid-market organisations.   You will also serve as a role model and mentor to newer SDRs, sharing best practices and helping elevate overall team performance. How you will shape sales development at Achievers: Generate qualified sales opportunities through strategic outbound prospecting across assigned EMEA territories. Conduct research and account mapping to identify key decision-makers, influencers, and buying committees within target organisations. Build relationships with multiple stakeholders across prospective accounts to increase account penetration and create new business opportunities. Partner closely with Account Executives to develop account strategies, progress opportunities, and drive pipeline growth. description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. title: Senior Grab Crane Operative, Smugglers Way MRF
description: Step into a vital position at our Materials Recovery Facility (MRF) in Smugglers Way, Wandsworth. This is a fast‑paced, hands‑on operational role at the heart of London’s recycling system. Every day, you’ll be helping turn thousands of tonnes of commingled recyclables into high‑quality materials ready for reprocessing — ensuring that the city’s waste is handled safely, efficiently, and sustainably. As a Senior Grab Crane Operative, you’ll take ownership of managing and maintaining bunker levels, coordinating material arriving by dustcart for processing in the MRF. You’ll be the go‑to person for overseeing junior and agency operatives, giving direction, offering guidance, and ensuring everyone works to the highest safety and operational standards. You’ll also play a key role in liaising with TAC Control, Shift Supervisors and sampling teams to keep material quality high and operations flowing smoothly. Effective communication and calm decision‑making will be essential, especially in a busy environment where no two days look the same. This role also brings opportunities to contribute to wider operational planning — from resource allocation and maintenance coordination to supporting the smooth running of the site. You’ll be central to maintaining a safe, organised and high‑performing facility that helps keep London’s recycling moving. Please note: This role is Monday to Friday, 14:00 to 22:00. We’re looking for someone with experience in a similar environment — preferably within recycling, MRF operations or an engineering‑based setting. You should be comfortable making decisions in a high‑pressure operational setting, with a strong understanding of safe working practices and statutory requirements. Being a team player is essential. You’ll be guiding junior operatives, supporting colleagues across the facility, and ensuring that daily check sheets, paperwork and handovers are completed clearly and on time. Strong communication skills will help you keep everything running smoothly. You’ll need the willingness to work flexibly, including additional hours or alternative shifts as required. A practical mindset, hands‑on attitude and readiness to assist with wider site tasks — including cleaning and maintenance duties — will make you a great fit. If you’re driven, reliable and motivated by making a difference in essential environmental operations, you’ll thrive in this role and become a valued part of an experienced and dedicated team. Help Build Europe's Hypersonic Capability
 
At Hypersonica, we’re redefining what’s possible in European defence technology. We exist to deliver speed, resilience, and technological independence at a pace that sets a new standard. We are a small, elite team working on problems that matter, and solving them fast.
 
By joining Hypersonica, you’re not stepping into a predefined role. You’re joining a talent dense environment where every individual shapes the direction of the company. Our philosophy is to hire a small number of exceptional people with broad, deep technical capability, strong judgement, and the ability to operate autonomously.
 
We hire for talent, not rigid boxes. This role represents a business need, but the way it evolves will be shaped by the individual. If you’ve achieved what others said was impossible, or you bring a unique combination of skills that doesn’t fit a traditional mould, we want to hear from you. The work you do here directly contributes to Europe’s technological independence.

What you'll do

  • Own the system architecture and system model for Hypersonica’s high‑speed flight vehicles, ensuring mission intent, vehicle dynamics, avionics, and GNC form a coherent, verifiable whole. 

  • Lead aerospace systems architecture design, taking responsibility for how the vehicle is defined across disciplines from early concept through Preliminary Design Review (PDR) and beyond. 

  • Build and maintain the authoritative system requirements model, decomposing mission‑level objectives into clear, testable system and sub‑system requirements. 

  • Define and own the end‑to‑end system V‑model, including requirements validation, verification strategy, and clear readiness gates for Kick‑off and PDR. 

  • Apply model‑based systems engineering (MBSE) as a practical engineering tool, not a documentation exercise, ensuring traceability between requirements, models, analyses, and tests. 

  • Develop and deliver a 6‑DoF Guidance, Navigation, and Control (GNC) model to PDR standard, in close collaboration with flight physics and avionics engineers. 

  • Apply closed‑loop control theory in the context of high‑speed flight and military guidance, ensuring controllability, stability, and performance are understood at the system level. 

  • Integrate vehicle dynamics, control laws, sensors, and actuators into a coherent closed‑loop system representation. 

  • Identify system‑level risks early particularly around requirements gaps, controllability, observability, and verification — and drive mitigations decisively. 

  • Act as a technical authority across disciplines, keeping architectural decisions coherent as designs evolve at pace. 


Who you are

  • An experienced Systems Engineer with a strong track record in system architecture, requirements decomposition, and delivery in safety‑ or mission‑critical environments. 

  • Deeply fluent in model‑based systems engineering, with practical experience owning requirements models and using MBSE to drive real engineering decisions. 

  • Strong grounding in closed‑loop control theory, applied to high‑speed flight, guidance, and defence or military systems. 

  • Comfortable developing and working with 6‑DoF flight and GNC models, and understanding their implications at vehicle level. 

  • Experienced taking systems through early design gates (Kick‑off, PDR), not just theoretical or paper studies. 

  • Someone who thinks in system behaviours, interfaces, and failure modes, not isolated components. 

  • Confident operating in ambiguous, fast‑moving environments where decisions must be made with incomplete data. 

  • Technically credible across disciplines, able to challenge assumptions and close decisions without consensus theatre. 

  • Motivated by working on systems where performance, robustness, and national‑level impact genuinely matter. 


Security and Elgibility Requirement
Due to the nature of the work with the UK MOD, applicants must be a British Citizen (or Dual UK national with British citizenship) and eligible for UK Security Clearance (SC) and, where required, Developed Vetting (DV) 

What we offer

  • A mission driven environment with the opportunity to work on one of Europe’s most consequential defence challenges, with direct impact on sovereign capability and security. 

  • Daily collaboration with top experts across engineering, operations, and defence, with real opportunity to learn from the best, contribute, and grow. 

  • High ownership and autonomy; no time tracking, no micromanagement, just clear objectives and accountability for outcomes. 

  • A fast paced environment where good ideas are implemented quickly, and feedback from test and flight drives real decisions. 

  • A culture that values clarity, integrity, and excellence, and supports people who take initiative and push boundaries responsibly. 

  • Competitive compensation and real share options aligned to responsibility and impact, not tenure or hierarchy. 

At Hypersonica, every hire raises the bar. We are deliberately small, intensely capable, and deeply mission-driven. If this role feels like a strong fit, or if you believe you bring something exceptional that goes beyond the description, we encourage you to apply.
 
Hypersonica is an equal-opportunity employer and assesses candidates solely on merit, capability, and potential.
 
You can apply directly to this role or reach out to Nathan Sweeney, Head of Talent. We review every application and aim to respond to all candidates within two weeks, whether the answer is yes or no.

description: The mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning. Over 50 million people use Speechify's text-to-speech products to turn whatever they're reading – PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, websites – into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more. Speechify's text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its 2025 Design Award winner for Inclusivity.   Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting – Speechify has no office. These include frontend and backend engineers, AI research scientists, and others from Amazon, Microsoft, and Google, leading PhD programs like Stanford, high growth startups like Stripe, Vercel, Bolt, and many founders of their own companies. Overview We're looking to hire for our Data side of our AI team at Speechify. This role is responsible for all aspects of data collection to support our model training operations. We are able to build high-quality datasets at petabyte-scale and low cost through a tight integration of infrastructure, engineering, and research work. We are looking for a skilled Software Engineer to join us. What You'll Do Be scrappy to find new sources of audio data and bring it into our ingestion pipeline Operate and extend the cloud infrastructure for our ingestion pipeline, currently running on GCP and managed with Terraform. Collaborate closely with our Scientists to shift the cost/throughput/quality frontier, delivering richer data at bigger scale and lower cost to power our next-generation models. Collaborate with others on the AI Team and Speechify Leadership to craft the AI Team's dataset roadmap to power Speechify's next-generation consumer and enterprise products. An Ideal Candidate Should Have BS/MS/PhD in Computer Science or a related field. 5+ years of industry experience in software development. Proficiency with bash/Python scripting in Linux environments Proficiency in Docker and Infrastructure-as-Code concepts and professional experience with at least one major Cloud Provider (we use GCP) Experience with web crawlers, large-scale data processing workflows is a plus Ability to handle multiple tasks and adapt to changing priorities. Strong communication skills, both written and verbal. What we offer A fast-growing environment where you can help shape the company and product. An entrepreneurial-minded team that supports risk, intuition, and hustle. A hands-off management approach so you can focus and do your best work. An opportunity to make a big impact in a transformative industry. Competitive salaries, a friendly and laid-back atmosphere, and a commitment to building a great asynchronous culture. Opportunity to work on a life-changing product that millions of people use. Build products that directly impact and support people with learning differences like dyslexia, ADD, low vision, concussions, autism, and more. Work in one of the fastest-growing sectors of tech, the intersection of artificial intelligence and audio. Think you're a good fit for this job?  Tell us more about yourself and why you're interested in the role when you apply. And don't forget to include links to your portfolio and LinkedIn. Not looking but know someone who would make a great fit?  Refer them!  Speechify is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace.  Speechify does not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other legally protected status. Speechify's text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its 2025 Design Award winner for Inclusivity.  

Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting – Speechify has no office. These include frontend and backend engineers, AI research scientists, and others from Amazon, Microsoft, and Google, leading PhD programs like Stanford, high growth startups like Stripe, Vercel, Bolt, and many founders of their own companies.

Overview

We're looking to hire for our Data side of our AI team at Speechify. This role is responsible for all aspects of data collection to support our model training operations. We are able to build high-quality datasets at petabyte-scale and low cost through a tight integration of infrastructure, engineering, and research work. We are looking for a skilled Software Engineer to join us.

What You'll Do

  • Be scrappy to find new sources of audio data and bring it into our ingestion pipeline
  • Operate and extend the cloud infrastructure for our ingestion pipeline, currently running on GCP and managed with Terraform.
  • Collaborate closely with our Scientists to shift the cost/throughput/quality frontier, delivering richer data at bigger scale and lower cost to power our next-generation models.
  • Collaborate with others on the AI Team and Speechify Leadership to craft the AI Team's dataset roadmap to power Speechify's next-generation consumer and enterprise products.

An Ideal Candidate Should Have

  • BS/MS/PhD in Computer Science or a related field.
  • 5+ years of industry experience in software development.
  • Proficiency with bash/Python scripting in Linux environments
  • Proficiency in Docker and Infrastructure-as-Code concepts and professional experience with at least one major Cloud Provider (we use GCP)
  • Experience with web crawlers, large-scale data processing workflows is a plus
  • Ability to handle multiple tasks and adapt to changing priorities.
  • Strong communication skills, both written and verbal.

What we offer

  • A fast-growing environment where you can help shape the company and product.
  • An entrepreneurial-minded team that supports risk, intuition, and hustle.
  • A hands-off management approach so you can focus and do your best work.
  • An opportunity to make a big impact in a transformative industry.
  • Competitive salaries, a friendly and laid-back atmosphere, and a commitment to building a great asynchronous culture.
  • Opportunity to work on a life-changing product that millions of people use.
  • Build products that directly impact and support people with learning differences like dyslexia, ADD, low vision, concussions, autism, and more.
  • Work in one of the fastest-growing sectors of tech, the intersection of artificial intelligence and audio.

Think you're a good fit for this job? 

Tell us more about yourself and why you're interested in the role when you apply.
And don't forget to include links to your portfolio and LinkedIn.

Not looking but know someone who would make a great fit? 

Refer them! 

Speechify is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. 

Speechify does not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other legally protected status.
